vision.name: Surprise Attack
vision.text:
(Players cannot search for "Surprise Attack" with this card's effect.)
[Attack] Physical attack.
Search your opponent's Life Deck for 2 non-Styled/non-Dragon Ball cards and banish them. Your opponent searches your Life Deck for 2 non-Styled/non-Dragon Ball cards and banishes them.
DAMAGE: 4 life cards.
HIT: Banish the top 4 cards of your opponent's discard pile.
